newsitem.title: UK: HTV chairman seeks licence renewal timetable.
newsitem.headline: HTV chairman seeks licence renewal timetable.

text.p: The chairman of UK regional television company HTV Group Plc, Louis Sherwood, on Wednesday called on the Independent Television Commission (ITC) to publish its timetable for licence renewal.
Sherwood, speaking to the group's annual general meeting, said this was needed to ensure Channel 3 licencees are reviewed on an individual basis.
"If ITV and HTV are to be able to plan accurately for the next licence period then we do need to know soon precisely what these future licence payments will be," Sherwood said.
He said all ITV companies have to agree the 1999 network programme budget at the end of this year and this cannot be properly done unless 1999 costs can be forecast.

"I urge the ITC therefore to make public soon the timetable and details of the process for licence renewal. Importantly we would also urge them to confirm that they will review each licence on an individual basis," he added.
Sherwood said a detailed analysis was needed for what the future holds for each region.
"We are confident that such a sensible and thorough review can be achieved and that the net result will be a very significant licence reduction for HTV."
